description: Fast feudal age-up with instant 2x Keshik into archers with late trade.
name: 4:30 Feudal Rush Mongol
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Age up with 3@resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.png@ on either @landmark_mongols/the-silver-tree.png@ for trade / @landmark_mongols/deer-stones.png@ if Trade Posts spawn bad. (add markets later)

Keep building army and when you can, start adding traders. Ultimately you want to take full map control, pocket resources, then go castle, get veterancy upgrades and win with a castle timing attack through @landmark_mongols/kurultai.webp@.

description:
Fast mongol rax into trush.

Video linked
name: Mongol Tower Rush FULL GUIDE
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 5 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ and place @building_mongols/ger.png@ beside @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ for drop-off

Pull the 3 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.png@ (enough for 2nd @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@x2 + @building_defensive/outpost.png@) & send them to @resource/resource_gold.png@ with starting @building_mongols/ger.png@

Queue @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@x2 & send 1 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.png@ to build @building_defensive/outpost.png@ on @resource/resource_gold.png@/@resource/resource_wood.png@ (dependent on matchup)
Remacro and @resource/rally.webp@@resource/sheep.png@ until 11 (Your desired macro is 11f / 7w / 5g then rest to wood)
Start full-producing @unit_mongols/keshik-2.webp@@unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ and raid/look for good fights.
If opponent is very defensive (i.e. defensive landmark or other...) then build 1-2 @building_economy/market.png@ if on @landmark_mongols/deer-stones.png@
If you got your @building_economy/town-center.png@ on @building_mongols/ovoo.png@ then x2 produce @unit_worker/villager-mongols.png@
If up against @civilization_flag/mal.png@ or other raidable civs: go for mass feudal and get improved @technology_mongols/raid-bounty.png@ + @technology_mongols/stone-bounty.png@for 150res per house.

If against @civilization_flag/rus.png@@civilization_flag/eng.png@ focus on your trade boom instead of raiding. Try to contain your opponent and read into what strat is used from them (boom = outboom them, Aggro = play aggro too and take a good fight, FC = FC yourself with a few traders)
If against @civilization_flag/ott.png@ focus on making spears in dark age to deal with them early and prevent feudal age-up.
Your victory condition in the long run is to setup trade and outscale.
Instantly queue 2x@unit_mongols/mangudai.png@ from @building_military/archery-range.png@ and harass, also make @unit_mongols/khans-hunter.png@ at some point
@abilities/repair.png@ a @building_economy/market.png@ and start trading (if the opponent is going Fast Castle you can go two @building_economy/market.png@ and be greedy while harassing the opponent}
Shift 4 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ to get wood for @unit_worker/trader.png@

keep @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.png@ (You can shift the @resource/resource_food.png@ @unit_worker/villager-mongols.png@ to other Resources like @resource/resource_wood.png@ or @resource/resource_gold.png@ depending on what you need the most

Keep Spamming @unit_mongols/mangudai.png@ and harass , if the opponent retaliates back with archers make @unit_mongols/keshik-2.png@ or @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ since you get buff with @unit_mongols/khan-1.png@ and @unit_mongols/khans-hunter.png@
go to 8 on @resource/resource_wood.png@ to preduce @unit_worker/trader.png@ and @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@
when 8 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ get 6 on @resource/resource_gold.png@, after @resource/rally.png@ to @resource/resource_food.png@

notes: Build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ up against the main @building_economy/town-center.png@ with 15 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.png@
